summary: Global Mofy AI Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held September 2, 2026. Shareholders approved all five proposals, including ratification of a 50-for-1 share consolidation effective June 11, 2026, adoption of amended charter documents, and related capital changes. Voting totaled 79.65% of outstanding voting power. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special-situation event.
